title: Studio Vistara
desc: A geometric identity for an architecture studio.
lead: I designed Studio Vistara’s identity and explored it across signage, print, website layouts and motion.
body: I built the identity around a line-drawn architectural mark, then carried it into print and digital applications.
detail: The presentation brings together signage, business cards, posters and website mockups. A 3D animation explores the mark through depth and movement.
contribution: Designed the logo and visual identity.
Developed signage, print and digital applications.
Extended the mark into a 3D animation.

story.challenge: Create an identity that connects with architecture and works across physical and digital formats.
story.ownership: I designed the logo and visual identity, then developed applications across architectural signage, printed material and campaign layouts.
decisions: I used a geometric line-drawn mark to reference architectural structure.
I paired the mark with clear typography across signage, print and website mockups.
I explored the mark in 3D to bring depth and movement to the identity.
story.result: An identity system presented across signage, print, website mockups and an animated logo.

context: Brand identity for an architecture studio
summary: I designed Studio Vistara’s identity and explored it across signage, print, website layouts and motion.
